metadata.description: Zero-trust Seccomp BPF filter for Firecracker microVM VMM, vCPU, and SHM worker threads. Enforces strict default-deny (TRAP/EPERM) and blocks all dangerous kernel/host attack vectors.

blocked_dangerous_syscalls.threat: Process tracing, memory tampering, registers hijacking

mprotect.comment: Disallow PROT_EXEC on runtime memory changes

shm_device.comments: Dedicated zero-copy SHM ring buffer worker thread. Disallows all socket and filesystem operations, operating solely via atomic spin, futex, and eventfd signaling over pre-mapped shared memory.
